fuels.source: Diesel/petrol: Singapore Emission Factors Registry (SEFR) / NEA. CNG: UK DEFRA 2023 conversion factors via Climatiq (2562.57 kg CO2e/tonne stationary combustion), verified 2026-09-17 — was previously 2.15, understated by ~19% relative to this sourced figure and to the stoichiometric pure-methane combustion value (~2.75 kg CO2/kg CH4); CNG is ~85-95% methane so a value just below 2.75 is expected.

naturalGas.source: UK DESNZ/DEFRA 2026 GHG Conversion Factors, natural gas stationary combustion (0.18231 kg CO2e/kWh GCV, converted at 277.78 kWh/GJ). No Singapore-specific natural gas combustion factor was found via search; this UK figure is a reasonable global-default stand-in since natural gas combustion chemistry doesn't vary meaningfully by country. Previously an unsourced IPCC-default placeholder — now DEFRA-sourced.
